issues.description: if-block placed mid-class-list breaks the file's structure and registers exp2 on the wrong template object
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` block is jammed in after `Math_unary` without a blank line, then *rebinds* the `Math_unary` name to the decorator result. This is wrong-shape: every subsequent reference to `Math_unary` now points at whatever `infer_global` returns, not the original class. Use `infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` as a statement without reassignment, and place it after the class block with proper spacing.

issues.description: `sys` is used in cpython/mathimpl.py and np/math/mathimpl.py without being imported
issues.detail: The diff adds `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` in both `numba/cpython/mathimpl.py` and `numba/np/math/mathimpl.py` but neither hunk adds `import sys`. If `sys` isn't already imported at the top of those files (the diff doesn't show it), this is a NameError at import time. Build-in-your-head test fails. Also: use `PYVERSION` like the test does, don't sprinkle raw `sys.version_info` checks across three files.

issues.description: Three different version-gate idioms for one feature: pick one
issues.detail: Typing uses `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)`, impls use `sys.version_info >= (3, 11)`, tests use `PYVERSION >= (3, 11)`. The codebase already has `numba.core.utils.PYVERSION` — that's the existing voice. Use it everywhere or you're making the next maintainer grep for two patterns.

issues.description: Release note file missing trailing newline and the underline is the wrong length
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends with `\ No newline at end of file` and the `------` underline is 30 chars under a 31-char title. RST is picky about underline length matching title length; some toolchains warn or error. Add the newline, match the underline. Two-second fix, no excuse to ship without it.

issues.description: Test coverage is thin: no edge cases, no parity-with-CPython check
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` — note the duplicated `-2` and `2`, which is sloppy. No test for `0` (exp2(0)==1), no negative float, no large value, no `inf`/`nan`, no comparison against CPython `math.exp2` for correctness. `run_unary` may cover some of this but the value list as written looks copy-pasted from `test_exp` without thought.

issues.description: Commit/PR does one thing — good — but the if-block has no blank line before it
issues.detail: Style nit that matches the codebase's actual rules: PEP 8 + numba's surrounding code uses two blank lines between top-level statements/classes. The new `if sys.version_info...` block in `mathdecl.py` has zero blank lines before it and one after. Match the existing voice of the file.

review.summary: REFUSE as submitted. Two P0s sink the patch: the `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` line rebinds the class name (wrong shape — the decorator call should be a bare statement), and `sys` is referenced in two impl files without an `import sys` visible in the diff, which is a NameError waiting to happen. Beyond that, the patch invents three different ways to spell "Python >= 3.11" when the codebase already has `PYVERSION`, the release note has a malformed RST underline and no trailing newline, and the test values look copy-pasted from `test_exp` with a duplicate and no edge cases. The shape of the feature is right — small, scoped, documented, tested, gated on Python version — but the execution needs another pass. NEEDS-WORK.
